video_title: Walker Kessler Wants To Be The Lakers' NEXT GREAT Big Man

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on the opportunity to play for the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: It was an opportunity to play for an organization like this and a fan base like this.
quotes.quote: I am so thankful. It was an opportunity to play for an organization like this and a fan base like this. Every time we go to practice facility and see all the Larry O'Brien trophies, it is insane. Even after my first regular season game, talking to Shaq after the game, he was like, 'Welcome to the Big Man Alliance.'

quotes.speaker: Flea
quotes.summary_phrase: Flea on the Lakers' improved team identity and consistency
quotes.excerpt: It is so exciting that you are there. Every time you go sit down I am like, oh.
quotes.quote: It is so exciting that you are there. Every time you go sit down I am like, oh, he is coming back. They are starting to find the rhythm. It is so for years now, with the Lakers, we have had some great players and some success, but it should have been when it is close games and in crunch time, you do not know what is going to happen. Now it just feels like we got this. With you holding down the paint in there and the way that it is working, the way that everyone is fulfilling their roles, it is clear and it is obvious and it is so consistent.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on the Lakers' defensive identity and bench depth
quotes.excerpt: We are playing hard-nosed ball, playing good basketball, even on the defensive side.
quotes.quote: We are playing hard-nosed ball, playing good basketball, even on the defensive side. We got to clean up some things in transition, but our half-court defense is fantastic right now. Obviously our offense, we got a lot of weapons and even guys coming off the bench, like Mo Bamba, for example. Mo Bamba is an unreal player. Immanuel Quickley is a great player, he played a great game last game. It is fun to play.

quotes.speaker: Tommy Alter
quotes.summary_phrase: Tommy Alter on the importance of locker room culture
quotes.excerpt: The overall energy of the team is good, even if you guys go on a losing streak.
quotes.quote: The overall energy of the team is good, even if you guys go on a losing streak, the energy of the team is probably still going to be pretty good internally. But we all know not every team is built that way. You can have a ton of talent, but the locker room is just a mess. If you get drafted there or you get traded there, there is nothing you can do about it, you are stuck there.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on the opportunity-based nature of the NBA
quotes.excerpt: The NBA and a lot of sports in general is opportunity-based.
quotes.quote: The NBA and a lot of sports in general is opportunity-based. I am sure there is a lot of really good players that never really got a fair shot and a lot of bad players that got a really good opportunity and some of them capitalize on it and some of them did not.

quotes.speaker: Flea
quotes.summary_phrase: Flea asks Walker Kessler about the chip on his shoulder
quotes.excerpt: Did you have get a chip on your shoulder this season because you got paid?
quotes.quote: Did you have get a chip on your shoulder this season because you got paid? Because I read all basketball press and stuff and they are like you got paid. I do not want anyone knowing what I am making. If I am doing well or not doing well, there are seasons to music. I do not want it announced in the press.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on his value and focus on winning
quotes.excerpt: I know what I am valued at, but I do not really care what they paid for.
quotes.quote: I know what I am valued at, but I do not really care what they paid for. I know what I am going to do when I get on the court. When I get in between these lines, I am going to control my paint, I am not going to let you score, I am going to do everything I can to win the game. Another reason why the Lakers right now are finding success is because at the end of the day, these guys just want to win. No one is really chasing individual stats right now.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on the Lakers' perimeter defense
quotes.excerpt: Everyone out there, Trey Murphy and Ziaire Williams and Immanuel Quickley, everyone is playing defense.
quotes.quote: Everyone out there, Trey Murphy and Ziaire Williams and Immanuel Quickley, everyone is playing defense in a way that the Lakers have not had. We had pretty good perimeter D, we had Alex Caruso and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, but it has not been that good since, and it is really great right now. I see everyone helping out.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on the Lakers' competitive culture
quotes.excerpt: The competitive culture that this team already seems to have.
quotes.quote: The competitive culture that this team already seems to have. They are out there playing with a fire and you can go into every game knowing that the Lakers are going to be right there because of the snap and the energy and the togetherness and really the fact that I see on the court sometimes you guys holding each other accountable.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on team accountability
quotes.excerpt: We are not afraid to call each other out and hold ourselves accountable.
quotes.quote: We are not afraid to call each other out and hold ourselves accountable. If I miss a call or I am late to a screen call or something like that, someone is going to say, walk, you got to be better. We are good, let us move on. Having an accountability is such an important thing. It is really easy to have high spirits when things are going well, but responding to adversity, responding to a team's run, regardless of how good your team is, you are still going against the best basketball players in the world.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on Greg Stiemsma's coaching advice
quotes.excerpt: Don't accept in victory what you wouldn't in defeat.
quotes.quote: One of the coaches on our team, his name is Greg Stiemsma, he says, 'Don't accept in victory what you wouldn't in defeat.' The mental lapses, the stuff like that, where in defeat you would be like, hey, we got to do this better, but in victory you would be like, oh, we won, we do not got to study. That is not how we are. We are like, hey, we won this game, but this last four minutes in the fourth quarter, look, we got to be way better than this.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on the Lakers' goal of a championship
quotes.excerpt: The end goal is a championship, and everything is working towards that.
quotes.quote: The end goal is a championship, and everything is working towards that and everything is working towards becoming more of a unit and everyone buying into their role for the hero's journey. That mentality for this team is why we are finding success right now.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson asks Walker Kessler about a nickname
quotes.excerpt: Have you thought of a nickname?
quotes.quote: Have you thought of a nickname? Shaq called me Milk Chamberlain, that was one. I am not saying I am being compared to Wilt Chamberlain, but Shaq called me Milk Chamberlain.

quotes.speaker: Tommy Alter
quotes.summary_phrase: Tommy Alter on Walker Kessler's Game of Thrones nickname
quotes.excerpt: I am a big Game of Thrones fan.
quotes.quote: I am a big Game of Thrones fan. Oh, White Walker. I have heard that one. You got to embrace it, man. You got to do the whole White Walker, because let us be honest, you are part of the Snow Time Lakers.

quotes.speaker: Flea
quotes.summary_phrase: Flea on the White Walker nickname
quotes.excerpt: I feel like you are too joyful to be the White Walker.
quotes.quote: I feel like you are too joyful to be the White Walker. The White Walker is like, I am in a bad mood, like death and mentor. But it kind of works, because he is the mentor.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on other potential nicknames
quotes.excerpt: Sheriff was another one, like Walker Texas Ranger, Sheriff.
quotes.quote: Sheriff was another one, like Walker Texas Ranger, Sheriff. They call me Sheriff. I have also heard, I do not like this one, but Blocker Kessler, block shots. Very simple.

quotes.speaker: Flea
quotes.summary_phrase: Flea on Mark Eaton as the original White Walker
quotes.excerpt: If you were like Mark Eaton, Mark Eaton was the White Walker.
quotes.quote: If you were like Mark Eaton, Mark Eaton was the White Walker. He was like, Eaten, he just looked like this guy that would kill you in an alley for the jazz.

quotes.speaker: Flea
quotes.summary_phrase: Flea on the nickname Cream Abdul-Jabbar
quotes.excerpt: What do they call him? Cream Abdul-Jabbar.
quotes.quote: What do they call him? Cream Abdul-Jabbar. Oh yeah, yeah, yeah. But like, you know, all the white jokes were pretty good, like all my friends, especially my black friends, were telling me so many white jokes.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on bringing 'white' back to the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: How does it feel to, you know, bring white back?
quotes.quote: How does it feel to, you know, bring white back? You guys are back. It is funny, because all Lakers fans, we were like, we saw, you know, so we got AR, we got Luka, Jake Laravia, consistent theme going.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on the irrelevance of race in basketball
quotes.excerpt: Regardless of if we are white, black, or whatever, we are just playing basketball.
quotes.quote: Regardless of if we are white, black, or whatever, we are just playing basketball, man, at the end of the day. I do not know. Again, Flea kind of spoke to it, how sports, music, all these, you know, creative areas, they unite people in such a way that like, it really does not matter. If you can play this game, you can play this game. It does not matter what you look like.
